rate_limits: Free/Developer/Business/Professional: RPC 10/50/200/500 requests/s; DAS & Enhanced APIs 2/10/50/100 requests/s. Enterprise limits are custom; special endpoint limits apply.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: ORIGINAL is incorrect because Helius documents plan-specific per-second limits distinct from credit billing; the corrected current limits are at https://www.helius.dev/docs/billing/rate-limits. example: Both verifiers are correct; the current balances route is /v1/wallet/{wallet}/balances and its response uses balances, totalUsdValue, and pagination, as documented at https://www.helius.dev/docs/api-reference/wallet-api/balances.
